snippet.title: Devolution Duel - Steam trailer
snippet.description:
The game of ultimate revenge for 2-4 players. Devolution Duel is a top-down arena shooter where there are no power-ups, only a bunch of unfair power-downs! Play with friends on the couch or online. 

Wishlist Devolution Duel: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4745100/Devolution_Duel/

Music by Michael Bergheim Fjelde

#indiegame #partygame #couchcoop #couchgaming
